You are polishing the CROBOT (ConvertScan) UI to premium SaaS quality (Hotjar/Linear/Vercel standard).

**Project path**: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT

Read EVERY file mentioned below BEFORE making changes. Keep all existing functionality intact.

## Fix 1: Card Shadows — Add baseline shadow-sm to ALL cards

### `src/components/shared/KpiCard.tsx`
- Find the Card component wrapper
- Change from `shadow-none` to `shadow-sm`
- Keep hover: `hover:shadow-md`

### `src/components/shared/FindingCard.tsx`
- Ensure cards have `shadow-sm` baseline
- Keep hover elevation

### `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`
- Find all Card components (Recent Scans, Quick Scan, Score Trend, Score Distribution, Quick Wins)
- Add `shadow-sm` if missing
- Ensure hover adds `hover:shadow-md transition-shadow`

### `src/pages/Reports.tsx`
- Report cards should have `shadow-sm` baseline

## Fix 2: PremiumLock — Replace blur with gradient overlay

### `src/components/shared/PremiumLock.tsx`
- Read the file first
- Replace `backdrop-blur-md` approach with a clean gradient overlay:
  ```
  bg-gradient-to-b from-white/60 via-white/80 to-white/95
  ```
- Remove `backdrop-blur-md`
- This makes locked content look "hidden behind glass" not "broken/disabled"

## Fix 3: Dashboard Table — Always show View button

### `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`
- Find the Recent Scans table rows
- Find the View/action button that has `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`
- Change to always visible: `text-primary/60 hover:text-primary transition-colors`
- Remove the opacity toggle

## Fix 4: Landing Page Section Spacing

### `src/pages/Landing.tsx`
- Read the full file
- Standardize ALL section padding to `py-24 sm:py-32` (currently mixes py-20 and py-24)
- Hero section: ensure `pt-32 pb-24` for proper breathing room

## Fix 5: Fix Gradient — Pure Indigo Brand

### `src/pages/Landing.tsx`
- Find any `to-violet-500` or `to-violet-600` gradients in the hero
- Replace with `to-indigo-400` or `to-primary/70` — keep it pure indigo, no violet
- The brand color is indigo-500 (#6366F1) ONLY

## Fix 6: Testimonials — Stronger Styling

### `src/pages/Landing.tsx`
- Find the testimonials section
- Quote icon: change `text-primary/30` to `text-primary/50` (make it bolder)
- Card background: add `bg-slate-50/50` or subtle background to distinguish from page
- Add `shadow-sm` to testimonial cards
- If star ratings exist, make them slightly larger
- Make testimonial names/titles more prominent

## Fix 7: Footer Upgrade

### `src/pages/Landing.tsx`
- Find the footer section
- Add a dark background: `bg-slate-900 text-slate-300` (matching sidebar color)
- Add company tagline under logo: "AI-powered CRO audits for modern teams"
- Add social links row (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, GitHub) with Lucide icons
- Organize links into columns: Product, Company, Legal, Connect
- Add newsletter CTA or "Start Free Scan" CTA at bottom
- Copyright: "2026 ConvertScan by Boldteq. All rights reserved."
- Make footer feel like Stripe/Linear footer quality

## Fix 8: ScoreRing Accessibility

### `src/components/shared/ScoreRing.tsx`
- Read the file
- Add `role="img"` and `aria-label={`CRO Score: ${score} out of 100`}` to the outer div

## Fix 9: Recharts — Use CSS Variables

### `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`
- Find Recharts gradient definitions with hardcoded `#6366F1`
- Replace with `hsl(var(--primary))` or keep the hex but add a comment explaining the CSS variable approach
- Actually: in Recharts SVG, CSS variables may not work directly. The best approach is to extract the hex to a constant at the top of the file:
  ```typescript
  const BRAND_PRIMARY = '#6366F1';
  const BRAND_PRIMARY_LIGHT = '#818CF8';
  ```
  And use those constants in all chart configs

## Fix 10: Animation Timing Scale

### `tailwind.config.ts`
- Read the file
- In the `animation` section, ensure consistent timing:
  - `fade-in`: 300ms (currently might be 400ms — standardize)
  - Add `slide-up`: `"slide-up 0.3s ease-out"` if not present
  - Add `scale-in`: `"scale-in 0.15s ease-out"` for hover states

### Throughout pages:
- Check `transition-all duration-200` vs `duration-300` vs `duration-700`
- Standardize: hover states = `duration-200`, expansions = `duration-300`, page transitions = `duration-500`
- Fix any `duration-700` (too slow) to `duration-500`

## Fix 11: Landing Page "How It Works" — Step badges shadow

### `src/pages/Landing.tsx`
- Find the How It Works section step number badges
- If they have `shadow-lg shadow-primary/25` — change to `shadow-md shadow-primary/15` (lighter, more refined)

## Fix 12: Pillar Progress Bars — Faster animation

### `src/pages/Landing.tsx` (Live Audit Preview section)
- Find pillar progress bar animations
- If `duration-700`, change to `duration-500`

## Fix 13: Dashboard Quick Scan Tags

### `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`
- Find the Quick Scan section tags (like "Takes ~30 seconds", "7 CRO pillars")
- Improve styling: add `border border-slate-200` alongside `bg-slate-100` for better definition

## IMPORTANT RULES
- Read EVERY file before modifying
- Make MINIMAL changes — only the specific CSS/styling fixes listed
- Don't restructure components or change logic
- Don't add new components unless absolutely needed
- TypeScript strict, no any
- Keep all existing functionality working

- `/src/components/shared/PremiumLock.tsx` — Removed `backdrop-blur-md`, replaced `bg-white/80` with `bg-gradient-to-b from-white/60 via-white/80 to-white/95`

**Fix 3 — Dashboard View button always visible**
- `/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — Removed `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity`, replaced with `text-primary/60 hover:text-primary transition-colors`

**Fix 4 — Section padding standardized**
- `/src/pages/Landing.tsx` — All sections changed from `py-20` to `py-24 sm:py-32`; hero changed to `pt-32 pb-24`

**Fix 5 — Hero gradient pure indigo**
- `/src/pages/Landing.tsx` — `to-violet-500` → `to-indigo-400`; also replaced `bg-violet-500/[0.03]` in Live Audit section glow with `bg-primary/[0.03]`

**Fix 6 — Testimonial cards stronger**
- `/src/pages/Landing.tsx` — Added `bg-slate-50/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow`; Quote icon `text-primary/30` → `text-primary/50`; avatar `h-9 w-9` → `h-10 w-10`; name `font-medium` → `font-semibold`; company `text-xs` → `text-xs font-medium`

**Fix 7 — Footer upgraded to dark**
- `/src/pages/Landing.tsx` — Full footer rebuild: `bg-slate-900 text-slate-300`, 4-column grid (Brand, Product, Company, Legal+Connect), "Start Free Scan" CTA, dark-themed social icons with `border-slate-700` borders, copyright updated to "2026 ConvertScan by Boldteq. All rights reserved."

**Fix 8 — ScoreRing accessibility**
- `/src/components/shared/ScoreRing.tsx` — Added `role="img"` and `aria-label={\`CRO Score: ${score} out of 100\`}`

**Fix 10 — Animation timing scale**
- `/tailwind.config.ts` — `fade-in` 400ms → 300ms; `scale-in` 300ms → 150ms; `slide-up` 500ms → 300ms

**Fix 11 — How It Works step badge shadow**

**Fix 12 — Pillar progress bar animation**
